implementation_status: Implemented; deliberately not executed by worker. Root must run the exposing oracle and consumer.
acquisition_outcome: All five requested official resources returned HTTP 200; exact original bodies saved. No alternate/failure outcomes occurred.

sources.name: AME2020 unrounded atomic mass table
citations: W.J. Huang, M. Wang, F.G. Kondev, G. Audi and S. Naimi, The AME2020 atomic mass evaluation (I), Chinese Physics C45, 030002 (2021).
M. Wang, W.J. Huang, F.G. Kondev, G. Audi and S. Naimi, The AME2020 atomic mass evaluation (II), Chinese Physics C45, 030003 (2021).
sources.format: Header lines 21-27: fixed Fortran fields; mass excess and uncertainty in keV; '#' replaces decimal point for estimated non-experimental values; '*' denotes unavailable quantity.
sources.used_for: Exact rational neutral-atom ground-state mass excesses, uncertainties, extrapolation flags and source-record evidence. No mass value is taken from the Kim proposal.
sources.covariance: Not acquired. Stoichiometric cancellation precedes uncertainty propagation; sum |c_i| sigma_i is reported only as an upper bound on standard uncertainty for unknown correlations, never as a confidence interval.

sources.name: NUBASE2020 ground-state properties
sources.citation: F.G. Kondev, M. Wang, W.J. Huang, S. Naimi and G. Audi, The NUBASE2020 evaluation of nuclear physics properties, Chinese Physics C45, 030001 (2021), DOI:10.1088/1674-1137/abddae.
sources.format: Original header columns 1-3 A, 5-7 Z, 8 state (0 ground state), 70-78 lifetime, 79-80 unit, 82-88 lifetime uncertainty, 89-102 spin/parity, 120-209 decay/intensity. Qualifiers and uncertainties retained verbatim.
sources.used_for: Ground-state daughters, lifetimes, spin/parity, inclusive decay modes, delayed proton subset and natural-abundance labels; no isotope composition is assigned to the specimen.

sources.name: NUBASE2020 interpretation article
sources.used_for: Section 2.5, printed page 030001-10: B+ includes electron capture and positron emission; ? versus =? differs; delayed-particle branches are subsets, not extra independent modes. NUBASE aggregates do not provide all ENSDF level feeding or radiation spectra.

sources.name: Kim generalized BECNF Ni/H proposal
sources.used_for: Defines Ni(A)+2p -> Cu(A+1)+p, Ni(A-2)+alpha, Zn(A+1)+n for A=58,60,62,64. Sign assertions for neutron channels are oracle hypotheses checked against AME, not inserted Q results. Its older quoted Cu decay values are NOT substituted for current acquired NUBASE values.
sources.not_established: The proposed spin-singlet proton pair, its population/lifetime/spatial wavefunction, Ni mobility and three-body transmission/amplitude are not supplied by this ledger.

sources.name: Inspected archived Hagelstein Models for nuclear fusion in the solid state manuscript
inspected: Section 6.9 DD/He4 approximate a-matrix and loss (Eqs. 395-398).
Section 6.10 HD/He3 angular/spatial overlap and a-matrix (Eqs. 440-448).
Section 6.30 proposed HD/He3 donor transfer to Ni* receiver, including missing fast DD-like loss.
sources.reusable_structure: Keep nuclear internal transition density separate from center-of-mass momentum/material modes and final product energies. Conditional DD/HD model coefficients are isotope/entrance-state specific; source has an approximate HD coefficient but no calibrated Ni receiver a-matrix.
sources.decision: No DD molecular kernel is substituted for commissioned Ni+2p channels. The source-inspected HD route requires actual D content, HD preparation, outer barrier overlap and Ni receiver data; none is fabricated here. No archive model coefficient is used in the Ni reaction ledger.

interfaces: nickel_channels(include_binary_capture=False) -> 12 Reaction objects; optionally four separate ordinary p+Ni radiative captures
reaction_energy(reaction, masses) -> EnergyLedger with exact Q_atomic_keV, signed stoichiometric coefficients, uncertainty upper bound and extrapolation labels
daughter_network(products, decays) -> inclusive qualified decay topology
two_body_kinetic_energies(available_keV, rest1_keV, rest2_keV) -> exact relativistic CM kinetic energies for explicitly supplied consistent two-body endpoints
equations: Q_atomic = sum_initial Delta(A,Z) - sum_final Delta(A,Z), with exact A and Z conservation; A*u and electron rest masses cancel.
Q_bare_nuclei = Q_atomic + sum_initial B_e - sum_final B_e for positive total electronic binding B_e. Material endpoint corrections require their actual electronic state.
W = rest1 + rest2 + available; T1 = available*(available+2*rest2)/(2*W), T2 = available*(available+2*rest1)/(2*W).

Available = Q + entrance CM kinetic - final excitation, with consistent charge-state/electronic corrections. Negative available energy forbids that endpoint; positive available energy does not establish a rate.

For weak daughter chains, atomic mass differences are Q_EC or Q_beta_minus reference quantities. A positron branch requires subtraction of 2*m_e*c^2 per positron before assigning its kinetic endpoint; neutrino energy and daughter excitation are not heat.

consumer.behavior: Authenticates original AME/NUBASE bytes, emits all 12 proposed channels and four separately labelled binary captures, exact Q and source raw records, full relevant daughter topology, lifetime/branch qualifiers and explicit transport/receiver gaps. No fused/deposited power is computed.

oracle.execution: Not run by worker as assigned; SymPy required in Root environment.
oracle.independent_inputs: Original-byte hashes, a second regex parser, and literal original AME decimal input anchors; no precomputed reaction Q substituted for calculation.
coverage: All isotope/channel Q formulas, exact A/Z and A*u/electron rest cancellation, neutron-channel sign hypotheses.
Wrong isotope/A, wrong Z, balanced wrong channel, reversed Q sign, exact finite mass perturbation, spectator-proton coefficient cancellation.
Decimal-input refinement at 0/3/6 places with an explicit rational rounding-error bound.
Independent relativistic two-body derivation, product swap, photon endpoint, threshold rejection, nonrelativistic limit and exact float rejection.
Ni56->Co56->Fe56; Cu59->Ni59->Co59; Cu61->Ni61; stable Cu63/Cu65; Zn59 delayed proton subset and neutron beta decay; preservation of unknown Ni58 double-beta mode.
Consumer contains no calculated fusion rate, heat rate or deposited product energy.

unresolved_physical_inputs: Specimen Ni/H/D isotopic inventory, nuclear spin/position/energy state and material-dependent entrance wavefunction through atomic-to-nuclear distances.

Physical proton-pair preparation/population/lifetime and three-body Ni+2p matrix element/transmission, or a justified sequential reaction mechanism with both steps. Ordinary proton capture Q equality is not mechanism equality.
Channel branching, final excited-state feeding and angular/momentum spectra. Q here uses ground-state endpoints, not an assigned nuclear excitation.
Ni receiver level energies, J^pi, lifetimes/partial widths and operator-specific spin-momentum transition density; appropriate nuclear-frequency medium coupling/spectral support.
ENSDF level and gamma/conversion feeding, EC versus positron split, weak spectral distributions and positron annihilation transport.

Charge-state/electronic endpoint corrections; charged stopping, neutron scattering/capture, photon conversion/absorption, geometry/escape and neutrino escape. Positive Q or absorption/norm loss is not deposited heat.
Full mass covariance for correlated statistical uncertainties; supplied L1 bound is not an independent-error estimate or confidence interval.
scope_preservation: Core N is advanced by a real evaluated-data reaction/product-energy construction, not declared solved as a Ni/H fusion-and-heat mechanism. No rates, proton pairing, Ni receiver matrix element or material nuclear-frequency absorption were invented.
